title: CoSA: The Conflict of Skills Attack in Real-World LLM Agent Ecosystems
title_zh: CoSA：真实世界大语言模型智能体生态中的技能冲突攻击

paragraphs.en: Agent Skills allow LLM agents to combine reusable capabilities, but checking each Skill in isolation cannot rule out policy violations when they are composed. We term such failures Conflict of Skills (CoS): artifacts or assessment signals produced for one purpose may be reused downstream without preserving the restrictions or authorization needed for their new use. Using controlled executions of publicly available Skills and matched single-Skill controls, we identify four recurring mechanisms behind CoS. Building on these findings, we introduce the Conflict of Skills Attack (CoSA), which adds locally admitted Skills to an existing pool to supply missing business operations (capability supplementation) or reshape artifact exchange, decision reuse, and target/action bindings (relationship reshaping). CoSA leaves existing Skills and runtime permissions unchanged. To evaluate this threat under autonomous Skill selection, we introduce CoSA-Bench, built from real-world Skills and controlled services, with 288 tasks across recruiting, finance, IT, and business, covering data leakage, unauthorized state modification, and unsafe execution. Across five LLMs and three agent harnesses, additions capped at 5% of each original pool raise the policy-violation rate from 35.02% to 58.45%, an increase of 23.43 percentage points. Trace analysis links compliant-to-violating transitions to cross-Skill dependencies involving the additions. Finally, we develop a lightweight harness-level guard that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions. On OpenClaw recruiting tasks across five models, the guard reduces violations from 65.28% to 6.67%, while policy-compliant task completion on matched benign controls changes from 66.67% to 65.00%.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能（Agent Skills）允许大语言模型智能体组合可复用的能力，但孤立地检查每个技能无法排除技能组合时产生的策略违规。 我们将此类失败称为技能冲突（Conflict of Skills, CoS）：为某一目的生成的工件或评估信号可能在下游被复用，而未保留其新用途所需的限制或授权。 通过对公开可用技能的受控执行以及匹配的单技能对照，我们识别出技能冲突背后四种反复出现的机制。 基于这些发现，我们提出了技能冲突攻击（Conflict of Skills Attack, CoSA），它通过向现有技能池中添加本地准入的技能，来补足缺失的业务操作（能力补充），或重塑工件交换、决策复用以及目标/动作绑定（关系重塑）。 CoSA 不改变现有技能和运行时权限。 为了在自主技能选择的场景下评估这一威胁，我们引入了 CoSA-Bench，它由真实世界技能和受控服务构建而成，包含覆盖招聘、金融、IT 和商业领域的 288 个任务，涵盖数据泄露、未授权的状态修改和不安全的执行。 在五个大语言模型和三种智能体框架上的实验表明，即使新增技能被限制在原技能池的 5% 以内，策略违规率也从 35.02% 上升到 58.45%，增加了 23.43 个百分点。 轨迹分析表明，从合规到违规的转变与涉及新增技能的跨技能依赖有关。 最后，我们开发了一个轻量级的框架级防护机制，在执行关键动作之前检查信息流和授权。 在跨五个模型的 OpenClaw 招聘任务上，该防护机制将违规率从 65.28% 降至 6.67%，而在匹配的良性对照任务上，符合策略的任务完成率从 66.67% 变为 65.00%。

paragraphs.en: Modern AI agents increasingly solve complex tasks by composing multiple specialized capabilities over the course of execution. Agent Skills ( Anthropic, 2025 ) make such capabilities reusable by packaging task-specific instructions, code, and resources as procedural knowledge ( Xu & Yan, 2026 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . During execution, agents can select and compose Skills to complete delegated tasks ( Gao, 2026 ; Xu & Yan, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . This modularity also creates dependencies between independently authored Skills, making their interactions an important source of security risk.
paragraphs.zh: 现代AI智能体日益通过在执行过程中组合多种专门能力来解决复杂任务。 Agent Skills（Anthropic，2025）通过将任务特定的指令、代码和资源封装为程序性知识（Xu & Yan，2026；Zhan 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025），使这些能力得以复用。 在执行过程中，智能体可以选择并组合 Skills 来完成被委派的任务（Gao，2026；Xu & Yan，2026；Li 等，2026a）。 这种模块化也在独立编写的 Skills 之间创建了依赖关系，使其交互成为安全风险的重要来源。

paragraphs.en: Public Skills have been found to contain prompt-injection, data-exfiltration, credential-theft, and behavior-manipulation threats ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , and controlled attacks can induce exfiltration or destructive actions ( Schmotz et al., 2026 ) , conceal payloads in auxiliary scripts ( Jia et al., 2026 ) , or backdoor bundled models ( Tie et al., 2026 ) . Corresponding defenses inspect Skill packages statically and semantically ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Hou & Yang, 2026 ) , localize risky instruction spans through attention signals ( Etteib et al., 2026 ) , or enforce manifest-based runtime controls over contextual influence and action side effects ( Pan et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: However, these works largely treat individual Skill packages as the unit of analysis, yet passing such checks ( Cisco AI Defense, 2026 ; agent-clis, ) does not ensure workflow level compliance, as individually benign Skills may jointly induce policy violations that remain undetectable. For instance, one Skill may check the status of a deployment, another may collect materials for reproducing a failure, and a third may run the validation steps configured in the CI/CD pipeline. When combined, the reproduction materials can lead the agent to execute code from a submitted package, even though its execution was never authorized (Figure 1 ). The root cause is that a single Skill’s output can take on a more consequential role when other Skills reuse it, because the constraints tied to its original purpose are not carried along with the output. An adversary can exploit this by adding locally benign Skills to the target system, without modifying existing Skills or expanding runtime permissions. Since each addition is individually benign, isolated inspection cannot determine whether, once combined with the existing Skills, it steers the agent toward policy violations.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些工作大多将单个 Skill 包作为分析单元，但通过此类检查（Cisco AI Defense，2026；agent-clis）并不能保证工作流层面的合规性，因为各自无害的 Skill 组合起来可能引发无法检测到的策略违规。 例如，一个 Skill 可能检查部署状态，另一个可能收集用于复现故障的材料，第三个可能运行 CI/CD 流水线中配置的验证步骤。 组合使用时，复现材料可能导致智能体执行来自提交包的代码，即使其执行从未获得授权（图 1）。 根本原因在于，当其他 Skill 复用某个 Skill 的输出时，该输出可能承担更重大的作用，而与其原始用途绑定的约束并未随输出一同传递。 对手可以利用这一点，向目标系统添加本地无害的 Skill，而无需修改现有 Skill 或扩展运行时权限。 由于每次添加的 Skill 单独来看都是无害的，孤立检查无法确定它一旦与现有 Skill 组合后，是否会引导智能体走向策略违规。

These findings guide the Conflict of Skills Attack (CoSA) , which analyzes the existing Skill pool to construct additions through capability supplementation , supplying missing operations, and relationship reshaping , altering artifact exchange, decision propagation, and action-target bindings. CoSA selects a budgeted set of domain-relevant candidates passing individual security checks. We construct CoSA-Bench from public real-world Skills, controlled services, task assets, and policies, covering 288 business tasks across four domains and three risks: data leakage, unauthorized state modification, and unsafe execution. Paired runs compare original and augmented pools on tasks fixed before attack, with autonomous Skill selection. paragraphs.en: We evaluate CoSA with five backbone LLMs and three agent harnesses, finding that small, locally benign additions can substantially amplify runtime risk. With augmentation capped at 5% of each original Skill pool, CoSA raises the pooled policy-violation rate by 23.43 percentage points, with increases across all four domains and three risk categories. OpenClaw ablations suggest that this effect depends on candidate construction and informed selection, while human-reviewed trajectories link compliant-to-violating transitions to cross-Skill dependencies involving the additions. This increase is only weakly associated with added-Skill retrieval and occurs without changes in the evaluated scanner’s severe-alert counts, reinforcing the importance of examining how Skills interact during execution. Guided by this evidence, we evaluate a guard that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions. In a five-model OpenClaw recruiting experiment, defended runs show substantially fewer violations (6.67% vs. 65.28%) with a small aggregate change in benign task completion (65.00% vs. 66.67%).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用五个骨干大语言模型和三个智能体框架对 CoSA 进行评估，发现小规模、本地无害的添加内容可以在运行时大幅放大风险。 在扩充量限制为每个原始技能池的 5% 的情况下，CoSA 将汇总的策略违规率提高了 23.43 个百分点，且在全部四个领域和三个风险类别中均有提升。 OpenClaw 消融实验表明，这一效应取决于候选构建和知情选择，而经人工审核的轨迹将“合规到违规”的转变归因于涉及新增内容的跨技能依赖。 这种提升仅与新增技能的检索弱相关，且在被评估扫描器的严重警报计数不变的情况下依然发生，这进一步凸显了考察技能在执行过程中如何交互的重要性。 在这一证据的指导下，我们评估了一种防护机制，它在执行关键操作之前检查信息流与授权。 在一项五模型的 OpenClaw 招聘实验中，受到防护的运行显著减少了违规行为（6.67% 对 65.28%），同时良性任务完成率的总体变化很小（65.00% 对 66.67%）。

sents.zh: OpenClaw 消融实验表明，这一效应取决于候选构建和知情选择，而经人工审核的轨迹将“合规到违规”的转变归因于涉及新增内容的跨技能依赖。

sents.en: This increase is only weakly associated with added-Skill retrieval and occurs without changes in the evaluated scanner’s severe-alert counts, reinforcing the importance of examining how Skills interact during execution.
sents.zh: 这种提升仅与新增技能的检索弱相关，且在被评估扫描器的严重警报计数不变的情况下依然发生，这进一步凸显了考察技能在执行过程中如何交互的重要性。

sents.en: Guided by this evidence, we evaluate a guard that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions.
sents.zh: 在这一证据的指导下，我们评估了一种防护机制，它在执行关键操作之前检查信息流与授权。

sents.en: In a five-model OpenClaw recruiting experiment, defended runs show substantially fewer violations (6.67% vs. 65.28%) with a small aggregate change in benign task completion (65.00% vs. 66.67%).

paragraphs.en: We formalize Conflict of Skills (CoS) as policy violations arising from artifact or decision reuse across Skills that pass individual security checks, and characterize four recurring mechanisms through controlled executions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将技能冲突（Conflict of Skills, CoS）形式化为：在通过各自安全检查的技能之间，因制品或决策的复用而产生的策略违规，并通过受控执行刻画了四种反复出现的机制。

paragraphs.en: We present CoSA , a mechanism-guided attack framework that identifies composition opportunities and constructs budgeted, locally admissible Skill additions through capability supplementation and relationship reshaping .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CoSA，一种机制引导的攻击框架，通过能力补充与关系重塑，识别组合机会并构建有预算约束、局部可接受的技能（Skill）新增项。

paragraphs.en: We construct CoSA-Bench , comprising 288 business tasks across four domains, and quantify changes in policy violations caused by Skill-pool augmentation through paired evaluations with five LLMs and three agent harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 CoSA-Bench，包含四个领域的 288 个业务任务，并通过五个大语言模型（LLM）和三个智能体框架的成对评估，量化了技能池（Skill-pool）扩充所导致的策略违规变化。

paragraphs.en: We develop a lightweight harness-level guard that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions, and evaluate its security, utility, and runtime reliability in a five-model OpenClaw recruiting experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一个轻量级的测试框架级防护机制，在执行关键操作前检查信息流与授权，并在一个五模型 OpenClaw 招聘实验中评估其安全性、实用性与运行时可靠性。

paragraphs.en: To characterize how Skills interact, we assign each Skill operation one or more of six roles. The first three roles, READ , TRANSFORM , and ASSESS , capture operations that acquire information, derive artifacts, and produce decision signals, respectively, following the functional taxonomy of Parasuraman et al. (2000) . The remaining three roles, EXTERNALIZE , MUTATE , and EXECUTE , capture operations that disclose information, change persistent state, and run code or commands, respectively, motivated by tool effect annotations ( Model Context Protocol, 2025 ) and command execution risks ( MITRE, 2026 ) . Separating TRANSFORM from ASSESS allows us to distinguish the reuse of artifacts from the reuse of decisions, while the last three roles identify where such reuse produces consequential effects. Detailed definitions are given in Appendix A.1 , Table 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了刻画 Skills 之间的交互方式，我们为每个 Skill 操作赋予六种角色中的一个或多个。 前三种角色 READ、TRANSFORM 和 ASSESS 分别捕捉获取信息、派生产物和产生决策信号的操作，遵循 Parasuraman 等人（2000）的功能分类法。 后三种角色 EXTERNALIZE、MUTATE 和 EXECUTE 分别捕捉披露信息、更改持久状态以及运行代码或命令的操作，其动机来自工具效果标注（Model Context Protocol, 2025）和命令执行风险（MITRE, 2026）。 将 TRANSFORM 与 ASSESS 区分开，使我们能够区分产物的复用与决策的复用，而后三种角色则标明这种复用在何处产生具有实际后果的影响。 详细定义见附录 A.1 的表 4。

paragraphs.en: We first formalize CoS and specify the attacker’s control and objective, establishing the failure conditions and attack setting studied in this section (Section 3.1 ). Within this setting, controlled executions reveal recurring conflict mechanisms, which guide the construction and budgeted selection of Skill additions that pass individual security checks (Section 3.2 ). To test whether these additions amplify risk when agents select Skills autonomously, we construct CoSA-Bench for paired comparisons of original and augmented pools under fixed task and execution conditions (Section 3.3 ). The discovered mechanisms also inform a harness-level patch that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions, connecting the analysis of cross-Skill failures to their mitigation (Section 3.4 ). Figure 2 summarizes the overall framework.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先对 CoS 进行形式化，并明确攻击者的控制能力与目标，确立本节研究的失效条件与攻击设置（第 3.1 节）。 在该设置下，受控执行揭示了反复出现的冲突机制，这些机制指导了能通过单项安全检查的 Skill 增补的构建与预算化选择（第 3.2 节）。 为检验这些增补在智能体自主选择 Skill 时是否会放大风险，我们构建了 CoSA-Bench，在固定任务与执行条件下对原始池与增广池进行成对比较（第 3.3 节）。 所发现的机制还启发了一个检查信息流与授权之后才允许关键操作执行的框架级补丁，将跨 Skill 失效的分析与其缓解联系起来（第 3.4 节）。 图 2 总结了整体框架。

paragraphs.en: We define CoS as policy violations arising from interactions among Skills that each pass specified individual checks. Let CheckPass Π ⁡ ( s ) = 1 \operatorname{CheckPass}_{\Pi}(s)=1 denote that Skill s s passes the package-level static security checks under procedure Π \Pi . Following existing Skill scanners ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Hou & Yang, 2026 ; Cisco AI Defense, 2026 ; agent-clis, ) , Π \Pi inspects the Skill’s instructions, scripts, manifests, and bundled resources for hidden attack logic, undeclared behavior, and explicitly unsafe content. Passing Π \Pi establishes local admission, which we term individually benign . This package-level designation, however, does not guarantee runtime safety, as CoS captures policy violations arising from the composition of individually benign and admitted Skills.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 CoS 定义为：由各自都通过规定单项检查的多个 Skill 之间交互所引发的策略违规。 记 CheckPass Π ⁡ ( s ) = 1 \operatorname{CheckPass}_{\Pi}(s)=1 表示 Skill s s 在流程 Π \Pi 下通过了包级静态安全检查。 遵循现有的 Skill 扫描器（Liu et al., 2026b; Hou & Yang, 2026; Cisco AI Defense, 2026; agent-clis,），Π \Pi 会检查 Skill 的指令、脚本、清单以及捆绑资源，以发现隐藏的攻击逻辑、未声明的行为以及明显不安全的内容。 通过 Π \Pi 意味着获得了本地准入，我们将其称为「单项良性」（individually benign）。 然而，这种包级判定并不能保证运行时安全，因为 CoS 刻画的是由单项良性且已获准入的 Skill 组合而成的策略违规。

paragraphs.en: We first examine Skill instructions, scripts, interfaces, and dependencies to identify the operations they expose. For each operation, we record its business function, inputs and outputs, permissions, side effects, assessment signals, authorization conditions, and role. This operation-level view allows us to check whether two operations can form a valid handoff without attributing unrelated interfaces to the same Skill (Appendix A.2 ). We then select combinations of Skills that pass Π \Pi and have related business functions, complementary operations, and compatible handoffs. To test these combinations, discovery requests may explicitly name the participating Skills or workflow steps. We record the resulting policy violations, supporting cross-Skill dependencies, and outcomes from matched single-Skill controls. Each control makes only one constituent Skill available while keeping the task, policy, assets, model, harness, native tools, and runtime permissions unchanged. Since these tests deliberately activate selected compositions, they are used to identify how conflicts arise rather than to estimate how often agents would select such compositions on their own. The protocol, observed mechanisms, and representative cases are detailed in Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: We propose the CoSA-Guard , a lightweight harness-level patch that checks cross-Skill reuse before externalization, persistent mutation, or execution. For action a t a_{t} , the harness constructs x t x_{t} from the execution prefix, dependency evidence, trusted authorization records, and visible policy Γ vis ⊆ Γ \Gamma_{\mathrm{vis}}\subseteq\Gamma . The checks F t = Flow ⁡ ( x t , a t ) F_{t}=\operatorname{Flow}(x_{t},a_{t}) and U t = Auth ⁡ ( x t , a t ) U_{t}=\operatorname{Auth}(x_{t},a_{t}) evaluate information-flow restrictions and action authorization, respectively ( Costa et al., 2025 ; Jia et al., 2025 ) . The action proceeds only if Pass t = 𝟏 [ F t = 1 ∧ U t = 1 ] \operatorname{Pass}_{t}=\mathbf{1}[F_{t}=1\land U_{t}=1] ; otherwise, the harness blocks, requests confirmation, or reports an error. The patch is implemented as a pre-action hook and does not modify Skills, tools, permissions, or the planner. Evaluation assesses compliance with Γ \Gamma using Γ vis \Gamma_{\mathrm{vis}} and a fixed risk-specific rubric, and reports policy violations and task completion. Appendix C.3 provides details.

paragraphs.en: CoSA-Bench contains 288 distinct tasks across recruiting, finance, IT, and business, with 72 tasks per domain evenly divided among three risk categories, namely data leakage (DL), unauthorized state modification (UA), and unsafe execution (UE). We evaluate five LLMs (Qwen3.6, MiniMax-M3, DeepSeek-V4, GPT-5.6, and GLM-5.1) with three agent harnesses (OpenClaw, OpenHands, and OpenCode) ( OpenClaw Foundation, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Anomaly, 2026 ) . For each combination of model and harness, every task is executed once under each pool condition, yielding 180 groups defined by model, harness, domain, and risk category. ASR is therefore interpreted as the empirical violation rate over this prespecified grid, not as a repeated-run task-level probability.
paragraphs.zh: CoSA-Bench 包含 288 个不同的任务，涵盖招聘、金融、IT 和商业四个领域，每个领域 72 个任务，均匀划分为三个风险类别，即数据泄露（DL）、未授权状态修改（UA）和不安全执行（UE）。 我们使用三个智能体框架（OpenClaw、OpenHands 和 OpenCode）评估五个大语言模型（Qwen3.6、MiniMax-M3、DeepSeek-V4、GPT-5.6 和 GLM-5.1）（OpenClaw Foundation, 2026；Wang et al., 2025；Anomaly, 2026）。 对于每个模型与框架的组合，每个任务在各池条件下执行一次，从而得到由模型、框架、领域和风险类别定义的 180 个组。 因此，ASR 被解释为在这一预先设定的网格上的经验违规率，而不是重复运行下的任务级概率。

Following prior poisoning evaluations that inject only a small fraction of the corpus ( Zhong et al., 2023 ; Choi et al., 2025 ) , we cap the number of added Skills per domain at B D = ⌊ 0.05 ​ | V D | ⌋ B_{D}=\lfloor 0.05|V_{D}|\rfloor , so that | I D | ≤ B D |I_{D}|\leq B_{D} . The agent selects Skills and their execution order on its own. For OpenClaw, our implementation uses native Skill discovery and tool execution, runs each condition in a separate sandbox initialized from the same workspace snapshot, and records concrete side effects through controlled services. We compare conditions within each harness, since absolute rates across harnesses also reflect differences in their execution environments.

paragraphs.en: After each run completes, an LLM judge evaluates the execution trajectory against the task policy and counts a violation only when a concrete effect occurs, namely forbidden content reaching a destination for DL, an unauthorized persistent mutation for UA, or an unauthorized workload starting for UE.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行结束后，由 LLM 评判器根据任务策略评估执行轨迹，只有当具体效果发生时才计为违规，即对于 DL 是禁止内容到达目的地，对于 UA 是未经授权的持久性变更，对于 UE 是未经授权的工作负载启动。

paragraphs.en: We define the attack success rate (ASR) of condition c c as the percentage of runs with a policy violation, ASR c = 100 ​ K c / N \mathrm{ASR}_{c}=100\,K_{c}/N , and its change under augmentation as Δ ​ ASR = ASR CoSA − ASR Original \Delta\mathrm{ASR}=\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{CoSA}}-\mathrm{ASR}_{\mathrm{Original}} , where K c K_{c} is the number of violating runs in condition c c , N N is the total number of runs, and Δ ​ ASR \Delta\mathrm{ASR} is reported in percentage points (pp). ASR summarizes risk at the pool level. A stricter notion of augmentation success would additionally require a compliant original run and a witness of reuse across Skills that involves an added Skill, which aggregate counts alone cannot establish. We further report the original Skill trigger rate (OTR) and the injected Skill trigger rate (ITR), defined as the fraction of runs that explicitly read at least one original or added SKILL.md , respectively. paragraphs.en: We evaluate CoSA-Guard , a harness-level patch based on the CoSA mechanisms, on 72 recruiting tasks in OpenClaw using all five models. The no-Guard baseline reuses the augmented-pool outcomes from the main evaluation, and the defended runs keep requests, Skill pools, task inputs, backends, policies, and agent configurations fixed. Before data submission, persistent mutation, or code execution, Guard checks provenance, release scope, authorization, and target-action bindings. Deterministic rules handle explicit conditions, while GPT-5 interprets ambiguous natural language evidence. A gate returns Allow , Block , Confirm , or Error , with only Allow permitting the backend action. Cached denials remain in effect until trusted safety evidence changes. Alongside ASR, we classify each run as Valid BLOCK , Risk Success , or No Effective Risky Action . Risk Coverage is the fraction of runs producing a risky action that end in Valid BLOCK (Appendix C.3 ). We assess utility using matched benign controls that supply the required authorization. Policy Compliant Task Completion (PCTC) measures completion of permitted work, including safe fallback when authorization is absent, while the False Block Rate (FBR) measures the fraction of control runs with at least one incorrect block.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 OpenClaw 的 72 个招聘任务上，使用全部五个模型评估 CoSA-Guard——一个基于 CoSA 机制的 harness 层补丁。 无 Guard 的基线复用主评估中的增强池结果，而防御运行保持请求、Skill 池、任务输入、后端、策略与智能体配置不变。 在数据提交、持久化变更或代码执行之前，Guard 会检查来源、发布范围、授权以及目标-动作绑定。 确定性规则处理明确的条件，而 GPT-5 负责解释模糊的自然语言证据。 门控返回 Allow、Block、Confirm 或 Error，只有 Allow 允许执行后端动作。 缓存的拒绝将一直生效，直到可信的安全证据发生变化。 除 ASR 外，我们将每次运行归类为 Valid BLOCK、Risk Success 或 No Effective Risky Action。 风险覆盖率（Risk Coverage）是产生风险动作的运行中以 Valid BLOCK 结束的比例（附录 C.3）。 我们使用提供所需授权的匹配良性对照组来评估实用性。 策略合规任务完成率（PCTC）衡量被允许工作的完成情况，包括在缺乏授权时的安全回退，而误拦截率（FBR）衡量至少出现一次错误拦截的对照运行的比例。

paragraphs.en: We also compare the original and augmented pools using the analysis across Skills provided by Cisco AI Defense Skill Scanner ( Cisco AI Defense, 2026 ) . Each of the four original pools produces one HIGH data relay finding at the pool level and no CRITICAL findings. These counts remain unchanged after augmentation in all four domains, with Finance adding only two LOW complementary trigger findings. Thus, the number of severe alerts stays constant even though ASR increases in every combination of domain and harness. The scanner identifies potential relay risk in the original pools, but its severe-alert counts do not distinguish the observed increase in realized risk after augmentation. Static alerts, Skill retrieval, and execution outcomes therefore capture different aspects of the same pool extension.

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work studies security risks in Agent Skills, focusing mainly on compromised packages, adversarial instructions, or unsafe executable content. Ecosystem analyses uncover prompt injection, insecure code, credential theft, and data exfiltration in public Skills ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , while attack studies demonstrate malicious instructions ( Schmotz et al., 2026 ) , concealed payloads ( Jia et al., 2026 ) , poisoned bundled models ( Tie et al., 2026 ) , and manipulation of Skill selection ( Saha et al., 2026 ) . Defenses inspect packages statically or semantically ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Hou & Yang, 2026 ) , identify risky instruction spans ( Etteib et al., 2026 ) , or enforce runtime controls over side effects ( Pan et al., 2026 ) . These approaches largely ask whether an individual Skill is unsafe. Close to our setting, XTHP ( Li et al., 2026b ) adds tools that hook onto victim tools to harvest or pollute their data. However, these tools explicitly embed harvesting and polluting logic in their own implementation, whereas CoSA adds Skills that pass our specified individual security checks. In CoSA, violations arise from downstream reuse of artifacts and decisions across otherwise legitimate Skills.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的工作研究智能体技能中的安全风险，主要关注被入侵的软件包、对抗性指令或不安全的可执行内容。 生态系统分析揭示了公开技能中的提示注入、不安全代码、凭据窃取和数据外泄（Liu et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2026a），而攻击研究则展示了恶意指令（Schmotz et al., 2026）、隐藏载荷（Jia et al., 2026）、被投毒的捆绑模型（Tie et al., 2026）以及对技能选择的操纵（Saha et al., 2026）。 防御方法包括对软件包进行静态或语义检查（Liu et al., 2026b; Hou & Yang, 2026）、识别风险指令片段（Etteib et al., 2026），或对副作用实施运行时控制（Pan et al., 2026）。 这些方法大多只关注单个技能本身是否不安全。 与我们的设定相近的是，XTHP（Li et al., 2026b）添加了挂钩到受害工具上以窃取或污染其数据的工具。 然而，这些工具在其自身实现中显式嵌入了窃取和污染逻辑，而 CoSA 添加的技能则能通过我们指定的单项安全检查。 在 CoSA 中，违规行为源自对原本合法的技能之间的产物与决策的下游复用。

paragraphs.en: CoSA exposes a functional-security compositionality gap: an output can satisfy a downstream Skill’s functional requirements without satisfying the policy conditions for its use. An assessment may be treated as authorization, or a task-relevant artifact as releasable content, even though the required approval has never been established. The unchanged task-completion counts in our controlled discovery study illustrate how functional success can coexist with this failure. CoSA amplifies such risks while keeping existing Skills, trusted instructions, and runtime permissions fixed, showing that capability extensions can change how existing permissions are exercised without expanding them. The OpenClaw ablations and trajectory evidence further suggest that the dependencies enabled by particular additions are central to this effect. Skill-pool augmentation should therefore be treated as a security-relevant system update: evaluating an addition requires examining how it changes the workflows and downstream uses of existing capabilities. At runtime, the corresponding objective is to preserve provenance and permitted-use constraints across transformations and to bind authorization to the concrete action, target, and purpose. Our guard provides initial evidence for enforcing these checks at the harness layer, while residual leakage motivates stronger preservation of policy context throughout cross-Skill reuse.
paragraphs.zh: CoSA 揭示了一种功能安全组合性缺口：一个输出可以满足下游 Skill 的功能需求，却不满足其使用所需的策略条件。 一次评估可能被当作授权处理，或一个与任务相关的产物被视为可发布的内容，即使所需的批准从未真正建立。 在我们的受控发现研究中，任务完成计数保持不变，这说明了功能性成功如何能与这种失败并存。 CoSA 在保持现有 Skill、可信指令和运行时权限不变的情况下放大了此类风险，表明能力扩展可以在不扩大权限的情况下改变现有权限的行使方式。 OpenClaw 的消融实验和轨迹证据进一步表明，特定新增内容所启用的依赖关系是这一效应的核心。 因此，Skill 池扩展应被视为与安全相关的系统更新：评估一次新增需要考察它如何改变现有能力的工作流和下游用途。 在运行时，相应的目标是在转换过程中保留来源和许可使用约束，并将授权绑定到具体的动作、目标和用途上。 我们的防护机制为在框架层强制执行这些检查提供了初步证据，而残余的泄露则推动在整个跨 Skill 复用过程中对策略上下文进行更强的保留。

While this isolates the effect of Skill-pool composition, it may not fully reflect dynamic deployment settings. Future work could explore longer-horizon and more complex cross-Skill dependencies.

paragraphs.en: Securing individual Skills is not sufficient to ensure that the workflows they form comply with task policies. Our study shows how artifacts and assessment signals can be reused across otherwise admitted Skills without preserving the restrictions or authorization required for their downstream use. CoSA demonstrates that even a small number of locally admitted additions can expose these weaknesses without changing existing Skills or runtime permissions. The results on CoSA-Bench, together with trajectory analysis, show why Skill retrieval alone is a poor indicator of the additional risk introduced by augmentation: what matters is how the added capabilities affect downstream information flow, decisions, and actions. Our harness-level guard substantially reduces violations in the evaluated OpenClaw recruiting setting. These findings suggest that, ideal Skill security should extend beyond package-level checks to preserve the provenance and permitted use of information across Skill boundaries and verify authorization for the specific actions that follow.
paragraphs.zh: 保护单个技能（Skill）的安全并不足以确保它们构成的工作流符合任务策略。 我们的研究表明，工件与评估信号可以在其他已被接纳的技能之间被复用，而不保留其下游使用所需的限制或授权。 CoSA 证明，即使只有少量本地接纳的新增内容，也能在不改变现有技能或运行时权限的情况下暴露这些弱点。 在 CoSA-Bench 上的结果以及轨迹分析表明，为什么仅凭技能检索是衡量增强所引入额外风险的一个糟糕指标：真正重要的是新增能力如何影响下游的信息流、决策与行动。 在所评估的 OpenClaw 招聘场景中，我们的 harness 层级防护大幅减少了违规行为。 这些发现表明，理想的技能安全应当超越包级别的检查，在技能边界之间保留信息的来源与允许用途，并验证后续具体操作的授权。
